script.problem: It has 6 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.

terra.problem: The statement that elders show up in Israel is a Bible fact from outside the passage and needs a reference.
Calling the water and dust the whole recipe overlooks the curses the priest later washes into the water.
Covering her head is not the opposite of letting down her hair. Both could happen together.
The statement that foot washing is in the Bible needs a reference outside this passage.
“Amen, Amen” is one word said twice, not two words said twice.
The dish joke makes the sacred ritual and its water the subject of the joke.
The text does not say what happens to the scroll afterward, so it does not establish that the scroll never makes it to the altar.
“The whole point of the card” refers to the lesson card, which Papa Dorin does not talk about.
The cookie comparison does not fit the action: counting cookies in a box and deciding whether they all go in the oven is not like burning a handful of an offering.
The statement that a ram of atonement appears in other laws needs a reference.
